data.one_liner: Android Picture‑In‑Picture mode plugin for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides API to check PIP availability, enter PIP, auto‑enter, callbacks, and a PipWidget for PIP‑dependent layouts.
use_when: Want automatic PIP when user presses home
Need callbacks for PIP state changes
data.setup_notes: Add android:supportsPictureInPicture=true to AndroidManifest.xml and inherit PipCallbackHelperActivityWrapper in MainActivity
